```python
causal_mask(seq_len)
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.ops`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/)

In-graph `(seq_len, seq_len)` f32 additive causal mask.

Entry `(i, j)` is `0.0` when `j <= i` (position `i` may attend to
`j`) and `MASK_NEG` above the diagonal. Composed from
`arange` + `less_equal` + `cast` + arithmetic — **not** an
`evoxc.constant` payload — so the mask costs four cheap ops per graph and
nothing is inlined into the emitted program.

## Parameters

- `seq_len` — int sequence length (must be positive).

## Returns

- `SymbolicTensor` f32 of shape `(seq_len, seq_len)`; add it to raw attention scores *before* the softmax.

## Raises

- `ValueError` — `seq_len` is not a positive integer.
